consumer: The pickup over-weight handler that presents the wear/wield/skip choice and acts on the player's selection — it asks 'which disposition did the player choose for this too-heavy item?'
scope: A single interactive selection among {wear, wield, skip} answered through the engine's real active input loop/menu query for the picked-up item
decisive_source: src/character.cpp::Character::weight_capacity — returns one max-carry mass scalar from strength/mutations/enchantments/worn/bionics; it is only an over-capacity precondition, not the chosen disposition
divergence: Two runs with the SAME item and SAME weight_capacity() value where the player picks 'wield' in one and 'skip' in the other: the capacity scalar is identical yet the correct outcome differs, so it cannot encode the choice
